meta.name: bear-notes
meta.description: Create, search, and manage Bear notes via grizzly CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、搜索和管理 Bear 笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常用 Bear 记笔记并希望用命令行高效操作
copy.tagline_en: Create, search, and manage Bear notes via command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Bear for notes and want CLI efficiency

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 grizzly 命令在 Bear 笔记应用中创建、搜索、读取和管理笔记。
howto.when: 当用户要求操作 Bear 笔记（如创建、搜索、添加内容）时触发。需要 macOS 系统且 Bear 应用已运行。

say.text: 帮我创建一个标题为“购物清单”的笔记，标签为 inbox。
say.note: Claude 会调用 grizzly 创建笔记。

say.text: 搜索标签为 work 的所有笔记。
say.note: Claude 会列出该标签下的笔记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, search, read, and manage notes in Bear app using the grizzly command.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to operate Bear notes (e.g., create, search, add content). Requires macOS and Bear app running.

say_en.text: Create a note titled 'Shopping List' with tag inbox.
say_en.note: Claude will call grizzly to create the note.

say_en.text: Search all notes with tag work.
say_en.note: Claude will list notes under that tag.
